explanation.owner_view:
Your tranche review has been assessed, and a physical site inspection is recommended before any further disbursement action can be finalized. Because no site photographs were provided with this request, the on-site construction progress could not be visually confirmed, resulting in a verified progress of 0% and a current verified value of INR 0.

Our overall cost analysis indicates an expected total construction cost of INR 22,47,079.18 for your 1,250 sqft project in Quthbullapur, Hyderabad. With a sanctioned loan amount of INR 15,00,000 that has already been cumulatively disbursed, there is an overall sanction gap of INR 7,47,079.18 and a cost-to-complete gap of INR -22,47,079 against remaining loan funds.

Additionally, our review of your contractor's Bill of Quantities (totaling INR 14,77,622 against a fair benchmark estimate of INR 14,89,022.20) identified key technical and contractual items you should clarify with your builder:

1. Steel Grade & Brand: Could you please specify the brand and grade of TMT steel bars (e.g., Fe500D/Fe550D) that will be supplied for the reinforcement work?
2. Tile Specifications: Could you provide details on the approved brands and base rate allowance per sqft for the 600x600 vitrified flooring tiles?
3. Electrical Point Breakdown: Could you provide a detailed itemised schedule of the electrical point types, wire makes, and modular switch brands included in this lump-sum rate (INR 36,073)?
4. Plumbing Class: Could you clarify the brand, pipe class/schedule, and fittings included per plumbing bathroom set (INR 50,505)?
5. Anti-Termite Treatment: Could you confirm the anti-termite chemical name, dilution ratio, and standard application methodology covered under this rate (INR 1,57,004)?
6. Structural Reinforcement: Total steel quantity (3,204.6 kg across 42.0 cum RCC, or 76.3 kg/cum) is below the typical benchmark range of 80–120 kg/cum. Could the structural drawings and bar bending schedule be shared to verify reinforcement safety?
7. Missing External Plaster: External plastering is missing from the BoQ scope (estimated at 127.7 sqm, valued at INR 30,648). Could you confirm whether external plastering is covered under the contract or treated as an extra cost?
8. Payment Milestone Alignment: The contractor has scheduled 55% payment prior to roof slab casting (standard benchmark is under 30%). Could the payment schedule be realigned to match physical milestones?
9. GST Terms: Could you clarify whether the quoted rates and contract total of INR 14,77,622 are inclusive or exclusive of GST?

Next Steps: A technical officer will schedule a physical inspection to confirm the exact stage of work on site and verify work completed.
